July 16, 2018
Sandra Little
Director of Operations
Salazar-Mendoza
Dear Ms. Little,
This letter sets out the terms on which Saltmarsh Environmental Partners will carry
out the sediment sampling program we discussed for Salazar-Mendoza, and it asks
for your countersignature so that a signed copy can go into the file before any work
begins. I have kept it plain on purpose. Where a clause below reads as boilerplate, it
is there because it has earned its place over many engagements, and not because a
form demanded it.
The program covers the collection and laboratory analysis of sediment at the
stations we agreed during our site visit. Samples will be collected under chain of
custody, delivered to an accredited laboratory, and analyzed for the parameters set
out in our scope discussion. The field method is a settled one, and we will follow it
as written rather than improvising on site, so that a reviewer reading the record
years from now can see exactly what was done, where, and when.
Results will be compiled in a data workbook, with each result tied to its station, its
sample identifier, and the date it was taken. I check the totals in that workbook
against the laboratory reports myself before anything is issued, because a figure I
have not verified is a figure I would not be able to defend, and the value of this kind
of work rests on being able to defend it. The program closes with a summary letter
report that states what was measured, where, and when, and stops there. We do not
editorialize a finding, and where the data leave a question open we will say so
plainly rather than paper over it.
You will work mainly with two of our people. John Sanchez, our Senior Scientist,
leads the technical side of the program and is responsible for the sampling design,
the laboratory coordination, and the report. Heather Morton, our Field Technician,
runs the sampling rounds and keeps the field record, which on a program like this is
as much a deliverable as the numbers themselves. I sign what leaves this office and
review the workbook before submission, so my name will be on the final report
alongside theirs.
Saltmarsh Environmental Partners LLC
Page 1 of 3

You will not have to chase us for status. We will send a short written report at about
the midpoint and again as we near the end, and there will be a working session or
two along the way with your site contact, so that nothing about access or scheduling
has to be settled by email at the last minute. If a result ever looks like it needs your
attention before the final report, you will hear it from us when we see it, not at
delivery.
At the close of the program you will have three things: the summary report, the data
workbook that stands behind it, and the field record for every round. The report is
the document you would hand to an agency; the workbook and the field record are
what let anyone, including a reviewer years from now, check the report against what
was actually done. We keep copies of all three, and all three are yours.
Because the estuary is tidal, the rounds are planned around the water and the
weather rather than the calendar, so that each sample is clean and comparable with
the last. That sometimes means a round moves by a day or two; when it does,
Heather will let your site contact know in advance. None of that changes the fixed
fee, and none of it changes the stations or the method, which stay the same from the
first round to the last.
The fee for the program is a fixed $56,500, which covers the field collection, the
laboratory analysis at the agreed parameter list, the data workbook, and the
summary report. It does not cover work outside that scope, and if something on the
site turns out to call for more than we have described here, I will tell you before we
do it rather than after. We are prepared to begin on July 26, 2018, subject to site
access and to conditions on the estuary.
Fees and Payment
The fixed fee is invoiced in two parts: half on commencement and the balance on
delivery of the summary report. Invoices are due within thirty days. Laboratory
analysis is included at the parameter list we agreed; analysis added at your request
beyond that list is billed at cost, and only after you have approved the addition in
writing.
Term and Termination
The engagement runs from commencement until the summary report is delivered
and accepted. Either of us may end it on fifteen days' written notice. If you end it
partway through, you owe us for the fieldwork completed and the laboratory work
already committed to that point, and we will hand over the field record and any data
in hand so that nothing done so far is lost.
Saltmarsh Environmental Partners LLC
Page 2 of 3

Confidentiality
We treat the site data, your business information, and the fact of this engagement as
confidential, and we do not discuss them outside the firm without your consent. The
one exception is a disclosure required by law or by an agency with jurisdiction over
the site, and in that event we will tell you what is being disclosed and to whom, so
far as we are permitted to.
Limitation of Liability
Our work rests on the conditions found at the sampling stations on the days they
were sampled, and sediment conditions can vary across a site and over time. Our
liability for the engagement is limited to the amount of the fee, and we are not
responsible for decisions others make on the basis of the report beyond what the
data in it actually support. This is not a hedge against doing the work carefully; it is
a plain recognition of what a sampling program can and cannot tell you.
Governing Law
This agreement is governed by the law of the state in which the site sits, and any
dispute under it will be resolved there.
If these terms match your understanding, please sign below and return one copy to
me, keeping the other for your file. If anything here reads differently from what we
discussed, call me before you sign and we will settle it then. I am glad to be doing
this work with you, and I think the record it produces will be one you can rely on.
Angela Flynn
Managing Principal
Date: July 16, 2018
Sandra Little
Director of Operations, Salazar-Mendoza
Date: July 16, 2018
Saltmarsh Environmental Partners LLC
